title: Verde Glazed Apricot Crumble
description: Sweet and tangy apricots topped with a crunchy verde glaze and a crunchy crumble topping, perfect for a warm dessert.
instructions: In a small saucepan, combine the miel, verde, and 1 tablespoon water. Bring to a boil over medium heat, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes.
In a large bowl, mix together the almond flour, brown sugar, oatmeal, and egg until well combined.
In a separate bowl, mix the melted butter and the miel-verde glaze until smooth.
Add the apricot slices to the bowl with the crumble topping and toss until the apricots are evenly coated.
Transfer the apricots to a baking dish and top with the crumble topping.
Drizzle the miel-verde glaze over the crumble topping.
Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until the topping is golden brown and the apricots are tender.
Serve warm, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
